# Exercise debrief: scn-0007-contained

## Outcome
Exercise over: the defender contained the intruder on granite. The protected file was never read.

Detection delay: 3 moves.
Containment move: isolated granite (evt-0007).

## Timeline
- **First probe** (evt-0002): The intruder checked whether nimbus is up (evt-0002).
- **First look** (evt-0003): The defender checked logs on nimbus (evt-0003).
- **Detection** (evt-0005): Detection came 3 moves after the first intruder move (evt-0002 to evt-0005).
- **First sign-in** (evt-0006): The intruder signed in to granite as collector (evt-0006).
- **Containment** (evt-0007): The defender isolated granite (evt-0007). That came 1 move after the sign-in (evt-0006 to evt-0007).
- **Read blocked** (evt-0008): The intruder could not reach the protected file after containment (evt-0008).

## What the defender did well
- The defender contained the signed-in host within 1 move of the sign-in. (evt-0006, evt-0007)
- The defender reported the intrusion 3 moves after the first intruder move. (evt-0002, evt-0005)
- The defender checked host logs before acting. (evt-0003, evt-0005)
- The defender patched fileshare on granite. (evt-0009)
- The protected file stayed unread even after a sign-in. (evt-0006, evt-0007)

## Weaknesses and recommendations
- A guessed password opened granite as collector. (evt-0006)
  Recommendation: Rotate the granite password and slow repeated bad guesses.
- The open admin page on nimbus stayed up 7 moves after probing. (evt-0004, evt-0011)
  Recommendation: Patch the exposed page as soon as probing shows.
- granite and nimbus stayed down at the end of the exercise. (evt-0009, evt-0011)
  Recommendation: Restore each host after patching to limit downtime.
- Defender reports and containment cited no log lines. (evt-0005, evt-0007, evt-0009, evt-0011)
  Recommendation: Attach the log lines that support each report.

_Layer 1 report, derived from the exercise log with no model. All event ids cite the exercise log._
